items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I really got introduced to theater through my experience with The Connection... one of the guys who was an actor in the play got mad... He was playing a Chinese bartender in one of Bertolt Brecht’s plays

ctx.x: It’s been compared to a Waiting for Godot kind of . . .
Something like that. That’s true. They did a lot of Bertolt Brecht and other plays that – I really got introduced to theater through my experience with The Connection.
How much did the piece mutate, in a sense, over time, by your involvement and the involvement of the other musicians?
